message:
test(safety): no test host drives this PC's input -- explicit OFF proven before any client; a record-only OS-effect build (2026-10-28 injection finding)

Verifier urgent-check / decision; Codex codex_test_injection_finding.md rules 1-6 and Finding-2.

GNLinkStream injects input by default (host_args.hpp enableInputInjection = true).

- e2e_injection_guard.hpp: every test host gets its own --config {"enableInputInjection": false} (plus the runtime
  overrides the test set: a --config profile clears them, and without forceEncodedExperiment the host refused h264 and
  served nothing). Nothing connects before THIS launch said "input injection disabled (enableInputInjection=false)";
  enabled / another off reason ("unsupported mode") / a config not loaded / silence -> RESULT: INVALID, exit 2, before
  any client. Applied to host_standby_admission, host_punch_reply, host_migration, host_reboot_delegate,
  android_session_reboot, bwe_observe, host_control_deadline, host_two_dispatcher (the last two now read their host's
  stdout); host_fatal_exception gets the config only (its hosts die at a startup step on purpose). A --prelogin
  worker refuses any --config by design; no client ever connects to one in these tests.
- control_resume, viewer_mouse_xbutton, viewer_paste, viewer_release_all: their subject is the OS injection itself,
  and in window mode a KEY goes through SendInput when the target window has the focus -- refused unless
  REMOTE60_ALLOW_REAL_INPUT_TEST=1 (exit 3, RESULT: REFUSED). Receipt-only or record-sink conversion: their owners.
  viewer_prelogin_login is untouched and not run (verifier / Codex: banned until the user resumes it).
- os_input_effects.hpp: every OS input effect of the host in one place -- SendInput, input PostMessage, SetCursorPos
  (host_input_inject.cpp), the credential typing (logon_ui_target.cpp), the display wake (host_log.hpp: SendInput
  +1/-1 and the SC_MONITORPOWER broadcast, which the injection switch never covered), the secure broker's install /
  write. In the product they ARE the Win32 calls. In the new test build GNLinkStreamInputRecordTest
  (REMOTE60_OS_INPUT_RECORD_ONLY) each is recorded ("[os-input-record] ...", a Unicode run by length + hash only) and
  never performed; it says "os input effects=record-only" at startup. gnlink_check_fixed_server.py refuses a shipped
  GNLinkStream.exe carrying "os-input-record" (self-test 52/52; the product GNLinkStream.exe built here has none).
- e2e_injection_guard_test (pure): the gate's negative controls, 11/11. os_input_record_e2e_test: a phone session
  controller -> the record-only host -> dispatch -> recorded; cursor and foreground unchanged (built, not yet run:
  the measurement slot is held).

Not yet run: the guarded e2e (the slot file left by the stopped --config run waits for the user).
